governedAdmission.rule: Exact uploaded bodies adopted into governed reference custody; existing hashes remain unchanged; no legal or terminal approval.

behavior: Requires the fixed tracked input-manifest path and compares its actual bytes to the adoption digest.
Requires each expected family/source binding, recovery source identity, item identity, status, exact path, SHA-256, byte length and filename.
Rejects missing or wrong bytes, wrong family/source identity, duplicate acquired receipts, and extra contradictory family-bound source records.
Rejects stale custody rows that declare heldAs bytes conflicting with the governed path, digest or length; historical unresolved rows without heldAs remain bridgeable.
Keeps the resolver scoped to the seven recorded SOURCE_RECOVERY_WAVE1 families and never consults MASTER_QUEUE.

validation.syntax: node --check passed for both implementation files
validation.resolverClassResult: All seven families resolved through the governed helper; familySources returned expected IDs with no unresolvable custody conflicts.

knownFailures: pool-held source test cannot bind in this worker's intentionally partial corpus
same repair test cannot bind in this worker's intentionally partial corpus
fullSuite.scope: pre-existing worker-environment failures outside this resolver repair; no Kansas negative assertion remains

outOfScope: No CA packet build was run pending independent code review.
No source search, URL retry, queue edit, source-custody edit, shared manifest edit, claim-ledger commit, or closed-family work was performed.
The pre-existing uncommitted claim-ledger.json was preserved.
nextGate: Captain independent code review of the exact patch, then rerun only the seven recorded same-resolver-class prerequisite checks.
